rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); Chromium dithers CSS gradients, so a shallow gradient renders there as row noise while Pulp's undithered Skia fill quantized it into flat bands (linear-gradient(#101418, #161c22) over 600 px: 540 of 600 rows non-uniform in Chrome 156, 23 flat bands up to 60 px in Pulp). SkiaCanvas now installs every fill and stroke shader through skia_gradient::set_paint_shader, which enables SkPaint dithering for gradients and leaves image patterns undithered. Measured raster 538/600 and Graphite 430/600 non-uniform rows; no existing pixel test or golden moved. No design-import, Chromium, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'CSS linear gradient background is dithered on Graphite'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'CSS linear gradient background is dithered on the Skia raster backend'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Gradient dither measure separates dithered from banded Skia output'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'set_paint_shader leaves image shaders undithered'
